title: Control the qubit-qubit coupling with double superconducting resonators
summary: We experimentally studied the switching off processes in the double-resonator coupler superconducting quantum circuit. In both frequency and time-domain, we observed the variation of qubit-qubit effective coupling by tuning the frequency differences between qubits and the double-resonator coupler. According to the measurement results, by just shifting about 50 MHz of qubits' frequencies, we can tune the effective qubit-qubit coupling strength from switching off point to two qubit gate point (effective coupling larger than 5 MHz) in double-resonator superconducting quantum circuit.The…
